behavioral_notes.observation: Lead->opportunity conversion is a type flip on the SAME record, not a new document: _convert_opportunity_data writes type='opportunity', stamps date_conversion, sets partner_id (creating a res.partner via _handle_partner_assignment/_create_customer when missing), and assigns an initial stage_id via _stage_find; user/team are distributed round-robin by _handle_salesmen_assignment. Won/inactive leads are skipped.

Predictive Lead Scoring (PLS) computes win probability with a naive-Bayes classifier over crm.lead.scoring.frequency won/lost counts (0.1 smoothing for zero-frequency). automated_probability is written, and probability follows it only while is_automated_probability is set, so a manually overridden probability is preserved. Pure Python ML — invisible to metadata.

Stage pipeline encodes won/lost state, not a separate state field. Flipping a stage's is_won recomputes probabilities of all leads in it (won -> probability=100, un-won -> _compute_probabilities). action_set_won moves the lead to the matching is_won stage and sets probability=100; action_set_lost archives (active=False) and sets probability=0 plus a crm.lost.reason. won_status is derived from (probability, is_won, active).

The crm.ir_cron_crm_lead_assign cron and manual action allocate unassigned leads to teams by weighted-random workload (assignment_max), deduplicate/merge duplicate leads (_get_lead_duplicates / _merge_opportunity, unlinking losers), then round-robin to members by quota and call convert_opportunity. Side effects: lead merges, deletions, opportunity conversion, mail logs.

classification.apqc_category: 3.0 Market and Sell Products and Services (3.5.1 Manage leads / 3.5.2 Manage opportunities)
classification.rationale: CRM is a value-shop: it solves the cyclical problem of finding, qualifying and acquiring a customer rather than transforming inputs into outputs. Its core is the iterative diagnose-qualify-nurture loop (lead capture -> PLS scoring -> stage progression -> convert -> won/lost feedback that retrains scoring frequencies), and value rests on reputation/relationship, not a linear document chain. It is a primary activity feeding APQC 3.0 Market and Sell (3.5.1 leads, 3.5.2 opportunities); the won opportunity hands off to sale (chain). One could argue it is the chain's marketing-and-sell front-end, but the recursive qualify/nurture problem-solving and reputation dynamics make shop the better fit.
